expectation.entry: One actual Box reference; possible incoming n i32|undefined, no declaration allocation seed
expectation.firstWrite: Successful b.n=1 creates an initialized i32 field version
expectation.earlierRead: Same receiver/member read is dominated by first write; no call/branch/alias mutation intervenes. Its reaching version is firstWrite, not laterWrite.
expectation.capturedLocal: const after captures the read value; later store cannot change that copied binding
expectation.laterWrite: b.n=undefined creates a later initialized valid-undefined version for future field reads, not missing/native-uninitialized
expectation.return: Return refers to original after binding, with native i32/0GC obligation once actual reaching is proven. No reloaded b.n and no invented as/coercion.
expectation.domainProof: Source checker flow/type is retained evidence, not by itself an actual-domain proof. Consumer must independently establish order/member/alias/version reaching.
